options.text: Buying and running your own servers on-site
Renting computing resources over the internet and paying for what you use
A programming language for the web
Storing files only on your local hard drive

questions.explanation: Cloud computing means renting computing resources (servers, storage, databases, software) over the internet and paying per use, instead of owning the hardware.

questions.prompt: In the shared responsibility model, which items are ALWAYS the customer's responsibility, regardless of service model? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: Data, identities/accounts, and access management are always the customer's responsibility. The provider secures the physical datacenter and underlying infrastructure.

questions.prompt: The service model where you use finished software and manage almost nothing (like Microsoft 365) is abbreviated ____.
questions.explanation: SaaS (Software as a Service) delivers finished software over the web; the provider runs everything and you manage only your data and users.

questions.prompt: Order these from the MOST you manage yourself to the LEAST.
questions.explanation: On-premises means you manage everything; IaaS you manage the OS and up; PaaS you manage the app and data; SaaS you manage almost nothing.

questions.prompt: Match each deployment term to its description.

pairs.right: Shared provider datacenters open to everyone
Cloud infrastructure dedicated to one organization
Using more than one cloud provider

questions.explanation: Public is shared; private is dedicated to one organization; hybrid connects public and private; multicloud uses more than one provider.
